candidates.name: 3D Tiles
verified_facts: 3D Tiles is designed for streaming and rendering massive 3D geospatial content including photogrammetry, 3D buildings, BIM/CAD, instanced features and point clouds.
The standard defines a hierarchical data structure and tile formats for delivering renderable content.
semantic_limits: Efficient streaming or renderable 3D content does not certify bare-earth classification, vertical datum, source survey accuracy or parcel-height correctness.

candidates.name: Indexed 3D Scene Layers (I3S)
verified_facts: I3S defines an open 3D content-delivery format for streaming and distributing large volumes of 3D GIS data to mobile, web and desktop clients.
I3S content can be distributed using enterprise and cloud infrastructure.
semantic_limits: A scene-layer delivery format does not prove that displayed elevations are authoritative terrain measurements or meet the parcel result error budget.
